description: This Java source file defines the ScriptedIncomingMapping class, which implements a mapping function for incoming messages based on JavaScript scripting. It processes ExternalMessage objects, executes a JavaScript 'map' function within a Rhino JavaScript environment, and returns a list of Adaptable objects mapped from the message.

classes.name: ScriptedIncomingMapping
classes.description: A class implementing a message mapping function that uses JavaScript scripting to process ExternalMessage objects and produce a list of Adaptable objects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the JavaScript mapping function on the provided ExternalMessage, returning a list of Adaptable objects based on the script's output.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToNativeObject
methods.description: Creates a Rhino NativeObject representing the ExternalMessage, including headers, payload, and content type.

methods.name: getAdaptableFromObject
methods.description: Converts a JavaScript object to a JSON string and then maps it to an Adaptable via JSON parsing.
